artworks.artist: Charles West Cope
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in Memory of his brother, Donald Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene featuring a slumbering figure. The image depicts a sparse room with a bed, a small nightstand or table, a window, and a person lying in bed. Above the resting figure, there appears to be a faint, ethereal form. On the table next to the bed, a single burning lamp casts a soft glow illuminating an open book. The room is lined with curtains and a window is visible. The style of the drawing employs a stippling technique.
